serviceName: Status page, behind a Cloudflare Tunnel
description: Shows an Oculix status page on a subdomain such as status.example.com, for an Oculix server reached through a Cloudflare Tunnel: a CNAME to the tunnel, and the TXT record that shows the domain belongs to the page.
variableDescription: tunnel is the ID of the Cloudflare Tunnel in front of the Oculix server; token is the page's own code for the TXT record, shown on its domain settings.
